content: Steinberg, James P. (January 2007) authored an article titled Subdural empyema and other suppurative complications of paranasal sinusitis, which was published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases, Volume 7, Issue 1, on pages 62–67. The article is identified with the DOI 10.1016/S1473-3099(06)70688-0, and its ISSN is 1473-3099. The PubMed ID (PMID) for this publication is 17182345. Greenlee, John E. (January 2003) wrote an article titled Subdural Empyema, which appeared in Current Treatment Options in Neurology, Volume 5, Issue 1, on pages 13–22. The ISSN for this journal is 1092-8480, and the PubMed ID (PMID) for this article is 12521560.
